item.text:
ResStock **excludes dormitories and assisted care facilities, but includes high-rise apartment buildings**.

| Building type | Included? |
|---|---|
| Dormitories | No |
| Assisted care facilities | No |
| High-rise apartment buildings | Yes, as high-rise multifamily housing |

ResStock follows the U.S. Energy Information Administration’s definition of a housing unit. This excludes congregate housing but includes high-rise multifamily buildings, even when building codes classify them as commercial. See the [ResStock Technical Reference Guide, 2025.1, §5 “Introduction,” printed page 17](https://nrel.github.io/ResStock.github.io/assets/trd/ResStockTechnicalReferenceGuide_2025_1.pdf#page=18).
